content:
Maya CS: Quick ask — we need a concise outbound to affected onboarding customers in EU who hit the inference throttling yesterday evening. Draft below, please review for tone, asks, and credit language.

Olga CS-Mgr: Saw the incident notes. +1 to being proactive. Do we have a short list of accounts by risk (trial, renewal within 60d)?

Maya CS: Yes — attaching segments inline. Trials (T1): 8 accounts. High-touch renewals (R60): 3 accounts. Enterprise pilots (P): 4 accounts. We should personalize R60 and P.

Ravi AE: Can we get product to confirm ETA for full routing fix? Customers will ask for timeline.

Laura SRE: Root cause is known — autoscaling threshold undercounted cross-tenant KV cache pressure during a spike. Fix in rollout; we pushed a mitigation and capacity bump at 22:40 UTC. Full fix scheduled in the next deploy window ~03:15 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-20T22:05Z — Embedding inference throttling. Severity: P2. Status: mitigated by capacity bump.

Kofi Support: Draft customer-facing note looks good, but please add explicit action items and contact routing for urgent customers. Also include link to status page.

Maya CS: Good call. Draft v1 (please leave inline edits):

```
Hi {{CustomerName}},

We’re reaching out about a performance degradation you may have seen in onboarding runs on March 20th (22:00–22:45 UTC). Our serving layer experienced a throttling event affecting inference throughput for embedding and short-sequence chat requests in EU regions.

What happened: An autoscaling anomaly during a traffic spike led to temporary request throttling for some onboarding jobs. Our engineers applied a capacity bump and a mitigation at 22:40 UTC and scheduled a permanent fix in the next deploy window.

What we did for you:
- We prioritized queued onboarding jobs for affected accounts and retried them where possible.
- We granted a 10% usage credit for the impacted time window (applied automatically to your next invoice).
- For high-touch onboarding or pilot customers, your CSM will reach out with an offer for an expedited retry and live assist.

Next steps:
- If you still see stalled onboarding jobs, reply to this message or book time with your CSM here: <link>
- We’ll post an incident summary and RCA on our status page once the postmortem is complete.

We’re sorry for the disruption — we know onboarding momentum matters.

Thanks,
The Redwood Onboarding Team
```

Olga CS-Mgr: Strong. Suggest bumping credit to 15% for R60 accounts; mention entitlement to a one-off re-run and a live session.

Noah Finance: 15% sounds fine for the small set of renewals if we keep it capped. Recommend wording: "up to 15% credit" and we'll calculate per-account.

Sam Product: Add note that this was limited to EU inference pool variant v2.4 and does not affect Dedicated Reserved pools. Helps avoid alarm for Dedicated customers.

Maya CS: Thanks — editing draft accordingly. Updated snippet: "This incident affected onboarding jobs on the EU inference pool (v2.4) and did not impact Dedicated Reserved pools or Private deployments"

Ravi AE: For the R60 / pilots list, I'll prep tailored outreach templates and ping the AMs. Can we get names/emails for the 3 renewals?

Kofi Support: I'll add triage tags and create a ticket template for CS to escalate urgent stuck jobs — short checklist and SRE link.

Laura SRE: RCA will include timeline and the autoscaler threshold diff. ETA for high-level RCA doc: EOD tomorrow. Full technical postmortem: 72 hours.

Maya CS: Final asks before send:
- Olga: confirm language for "up to 15% credit" on R60 (ok?)
- Noah: confirm cap per-account (ok to cap at $5k?)
- Sam: confirm the Dedicated clarification wording (ok?)
- Laura: confirm status page link to include once posted

Olga CS-Mgr: OK to "up to 15%" for R60 and pilots. Personal outreach required.

Noah Finance: $5k cap per-account approved for this window.

Sam Product: Wording ok. Please also add: "If you use our embeddings batch API, expect retried batches to run automatically; no action needed unless you opt-out."

Maya CS: Great — I'll finalize and schedule sends in batches: T1 trials first (auto note), then R60/pilots (personalized). Draft will go to #customer-success-drafts for signoff.

Ravi AE: I'll assemble the renewals packet and join outreach sync at 09:30 PT.

Kofi Support: Ticket template created: #CS-ONBOARD-THROTTLE — fields: account, onboarding job id, timestamp, retry status, CSM owner.

Maya CS: Thank you everyone. Plan: send trial outbound at 07:00 UTC tomorrow, personalized outreach to renewals/pilots by 09:30 PT. If any blocker, flag here. :thumbsup:
